summary.text: Bobby McCool is a Republican state representative who has represented District 97 since 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Bobby McCool is vice-president and chief institutional officer at Big Sandy Community and Technical College and a veteran of the United States Marine Corps.
He and his wife, Debbie, have two children.

In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the House Veterans, Military Affairs, and Public Protection Committee and serves on the Natural Resources and Energy, Postsecondary Education, and Transportation committees.
